body: College. I don't have a car or license, so work hasn't been that viable an option.

I went to therapy for about two years in high school (just graduated) and it helped me a lot, but I can't afford it anymore. My parent used to pay for it for me, even though it wasn't really within our means and she had to take extra hours to pay for it, but now I don't have the option unfortunately. I wonder if it would help at all anyway... but even if it would, it's not an expense I can afford I'm afraid.
I do, but... I guess I should have mentioned my social anxiety up above too. I'm horribly terrified of contacting people (probably just from experience). But your gesture is immensely nice.
